data:scope-firms-miscounted.claim: 2PP scope line names Resolve as a source of the '5 published two-party figures' but Resolve's two in-window waves publish no 2PP (em-dash rows); the next line then says 'the same 7 polls', leaving the two scope lines inconsistent (5 vs 7)
data:scope-firms-miscounted.evidence: vic/index.html rendered scope vs table rows Resolve 13 Sep/16 Aug 2026 showing '—'; headNote firm list built from all headRows, not the 2PP-carrying subset (refresh-vic.mjs:387)

feature:charts-no-hover-values.claim: No chart offers a hover/tap affordance naming a point's value — 0 <title> elements on dots and no page-owned script; the standard requires one at least for head figures, and only the 2PP endpoint carries a static value label while FP and leaders charts have no on-chart values
feature:charts-no-hover-values.evidence: vic/index.html: 4 figures have no <title> children; only 2 scripts on page, both shell-owned (theme inline + /assets/site-shell.js)

visual:table-date-label-style.claim: Fieldwork column mixes date styles against the condensed en-dash main-page convention: '16 Jun - 10 July 2026' (hyphen-minus), '12–16 Jan& 8–14 Feb 2026' (glued '&'), '22–24 April 2026'/'12 July 2026' (months spelt out), '5 Aug–7 Aug 2026' (month repeated)
visual:table-date-label-style.evidence: vic/index.html poll table rows; sources are free-text dateLabel in data/vic-polls.json rendered verbatim at refresh-vic.mjs:421

visual:net-chart-axis-hyphen.claim: Net-satisfaction chart y-axis tick labels render ASCII hyphen-minus ('-50'…'-10'); the standard requires U+2212 minus for figures and body copy already uses it (−7)
visual:net-chart-axis-hyphen.evidence: vic/index.html fourth figure (net satisfaction) <text> elements: '-50','-40','-30','-20','-10' hyphen-minus

feature:fp-chart-missing-2022-marks.claim: D3: first-preferences chart carries no 2022 election reference marks; the standard demands official VEC statewide primaries labelled '2022 election' like the 2PP chart's Labor-55.0 baseline
feature:fp-chart-missing-2022-marks.evidence: pack check fp-2022-election-markers FAIL; vic/index.html fig 1 (line 288) has no 2022 marker while fig 0 has '2022 election: Labor 55.0'

feature:charts-missing-end-labels.claim: D2: only the 2PP chart carries a right-edge value label; FP chart's five series and both leaders charts end at the plot edge with nno on-chart values
feature:charts-missing-end-labels.evidence: pack FAILs chart-endlabels-f1-chart (0, needs 4+), chart-endlabels-f2-premier (0), chart-endlabels-f3-net (0); measured 0 <text> x>=600 in figs 2-3

feature:dot-titles-lack-span.claim: D1: hover titles name firm/date/value but never the fieldwork SPAN — 0 titles across all four figures carry the span though 47/64 waves are multi-day

feature:dot-titles-lack-sample.claim: D1: hover titles never name the sample ('n=1,234') though 100% of waves publish one
feature:dot-titles-lack-sample.evidence: pack FAILs chart-titles-sample-f0/f1/f2/f3 (0 titles carry a sample; census: 64/64 rows publish one)

feature:leaders-charts-no-series-legend.claim: D6: only the 2PP chart (fig 0) has a series legend; the FP chart's five series are keyed only by the distant hero chips, and the two leaders charts' coloured series are unkeyed anywhere on the page
feature:leaders-charts-no-series-legend.evidence: single <div class=vp-legend> at vic/index.html:274 (house key); figs 1-3 (lines 288,303,312) followed by no legend row

feature:hero-missing-2022-delta.claim: D7: hero duo shows 46.2/53.8 with basis clause but no delta statement against the 2022 election result (55.0/45.0)
feature:hero-missing-2022-delta.evidence: pack check hero-2022-delta FAIL; vic/index.html:253-257 hero + scope line lack any 2022 comparison

feature:polls-section-missing-dek.claim: D8: 'Every published poll' is the only content h2 with no gist dek — the h2 is followed straight by the table wrapper
feature:polls-section-missing-dek.evidence: pack check section-dek-every-published-poll FAIL; vic/index.html:321 h2 immediately followed by div.vp-twrap at :322

visual:leaders-charts-no-election-marker.claim: D5: the election-day plot-edge marker ('Election, 28 Nov') appears only on the 2PP and FP charts; both leaders charts lack it
visual:leaders-charts-no-election-marker.evidence: grep 'Election, 28 Nov' = 2 occurrences (figs 0,1); figs 2/3 (vic/index.html:303,312) have none

feature:hero-duo-no-countdown.claim: D7 demands the hero duo pair the current 2PP figure with a countdown-to-election figure in the hero type treatment, its clause naming the fixed date; the page's duo is Labor/Coalition 46.2/53.8 only, and '55 days out' appears solely as plain text in the ss-sub line
feature:hero-duo-no-countdown.evidence: vic/index.html:253-257 vp-duo holds the two 2PP numbers; countdown exists only as 'Assembled 4 October 2026 — 55 days out' at :252
